SimpleProduct:16017.faq:
What materials are these custom stickers made from?

These are high quality vinyl stickers.

Will these drink bottle labels work in the dishwasher?

Yes, they will stay stuck to most smooth bottles and containers in the dishwasher.

What can the personalised stickers be used on?

They can be easily stuck to most of your kid’s things, such as plastic bottles and containers. Being 100% waterproof they’re safe to use on most containers in dishwashers, sterilisers, microwaves and freezers. For further information, please see our FAQ Page

description.html:
Encourage your child to show off their interests with these vibrant Drink Bottle Stickers. Dinos, unicorns, ninjas, rainbows... whatever their current fave is, there's a design for it in these durable personalised stickers Australia loves.

Let your kids pick out the design and we'll ship your orders in a flash so you can get to the fun part... applying them! They're super easy to apply on most dry and smooth surfaces. Plus, your kids will love decorating their drink bottles and making them their own.

Best of all, you can rest easy knowing their drink bottles won't get mixed up or get lost in the shuffle at school or after school practice.

Love the idea of personalised drink bottles? Get your kids these custom Lunch Box Labels too! You can match the design with their drink bottle labels so they can easily keep track of their items.

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.
